title: indigo_uni_io never releases TIOCEXCL, so a Linux pseudo-terminal refuses every reopen with EBUSY
summary: indigo_uni_io opens serial ports with TIOCEXCL and closed them without TIOCNXCL. On Linux a pseudo-terminal slave keeps the exclusive flag after its last descriptor is closed while the master stays open, so the second open of a serial simulator port failed with 'Device or resource busy'. Every reconnect in a Linux simulator run failed: 9 of 54 focuser_primaluce cases and test_focuser_primaluce_motion. A failed open after a successful TIOCEXCL (tcsetattr error) left the port claimed the same way. Real serial ports are released when the tty is freed (the Linux arm64 hardware run of focuser_primaluce reconnects).
evidence: 010-primalucelib/verification.md (Baseline, FND-000049); standalone reproducer: open, TIOCEXCL, close, reopen -> EBUSY, with TIOCNXCL -> ok; indigo_test/unit/test_uni_io.c serial_port_reopens_after_close fails before the fix

resolution.evidence: 010-primalucelib/verification.md: indigo_uni_close and the open_tty error path issue TIOCNXCL before close(); serial_port_reopens_after_close fails before and passes after; make -C indigo_test test-unit passes; the 9 reconnect cases and the motion case pass in the recorded run.
